# donray.dev

> Personal portfolio of Donray Williams — player-coach Engineering Manager at
> Justworks, leading frontend for onboarding and billing. Based in New Jersey.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.donray.dev): hero, skills, projects, experience, and
  "open to conversations" section.
- [Analytics](https://www.donray.dev/analytics): public, privacy-respecting
  traffic stats — real page views and estimated unique visitors, plus
  historical CDN-request estimates.
- [Version](https://www.donray.dev/version): current build vs latest release.

## Background

- Engineering Manager at Justworks (Jun 2026–present), player-coach leading
  a team of 3 on frontend for member onboarding and billing.
- Previously Senior Software Engineer at Justworks (Jan 2023–Jun 2026) and
  Founding Frontend Engineer at Cyclei.
- Shipped the new member onboarding flow: 6,800+ people across 1,365
  companies in its first 30 days.
